name: mos-ui-shell
description: The MindrianOS UI shell: a walled Next package (Phase 369 D-07, bake-off winner: workroom). server/ holds framework-free security and session modules, client/ the React frame, app/ the thin Next route glue. Built by the maintainer for the release; only built assets ship. Never enters the plugin's root dependency tree (D-17).

scripts.build: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 next build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
